## Pricing

Public API, per 1M input tokens:
- Text: $0.05
- Image: $0.15
- Output tokens are never billed
- New accounts get 1M tokens free
- 1M-token context window on Summarize, Extract, and Classify; Compress has no limit
- Flat pricing, no tiers or seats

Enterprise: dedicated or licensed deployments, custom pricing
- Self-hosted in your VPC, including air-gapped
- Fine-tuning on your data
- Dedicated support and SLAs
